prompt:
Select the 3 categories with the largest Alpha values. Compute the mean of Beta for the final selected categories. All chart quantities are integer counts in [10,90]. Break ranking ties by printed left-to-right order. 
Return exactly one JSON object, with no Markdown fences or text outside it.
Write every key exactly once in each object.
Use these fields in the following suggested order; work is optional:
"evidence": an array of objects with exactly "series", "category", and "value". series and category are strings; value is an original chart cell NUMBER or exact numeric string, never an expression. A TYPE example is {"series":"Alpha","category":"Example_A","value":42}. Each object reports exactly ONE original chart cell: one series, one category, and one value. Never merge Alpha and Beta into the same object. Never repeat the same (series, category) cell in evidence.
"work": an OPTIONAL concise working string. If used, put it BEFORE selected, bindings, aggregate and answer. Complete calculations and corrections before writing the final declarations. Escape newlines inside JSON strings.
"selected": an array of STRINGS naming your FINAL adopted categories after every condition and filter. TYPE examples are ["Example_A", "Example_B"], or ["Example_A"] when only one category is adopted. Do NOT use objects such as [{"category":"Example_A"}] or report a preliminary candidate pool. Do not repeat labels. Order is irrelevant. Write the JSON array itself, not a single string containing an array and not a bare category string.
"bindings": an array with one object per finally selected category, with exactly "category" (a string) and "operand" (its computed NUMERIC VALUE). A TYPE example is {"category":"Example_A","operand":-18}. Use the requested Alpha value, Beta value, or already computed signed Alpha minus Beta for that category. Negative numbers are allowed. "Beta", "Alpha - Beta", and "60-48" are NOT numeric operands. Do not write an unquoted expression either. Order is irrelevant.
"aggregate": the string "sum" or "mean", as requested. Mean means arithmetic mean over your final selected categories.
"answer": the final exact result: an integer, an exact finite decimal, or a quoted fraction such as "17/3". Do not round repeating decimals or write unquoted fractions. Put answer last. It is the sole final answer; numbers in work do not replace it.
The examples illustrate types only. Use actual labels and values from THIS chart, never the Example_A/Example_B placeholders. Do not add extra fields. Evidence and bindings serve different roles: a number written only in bindings does not count as an evidence entry. Do not use external tools.
EVIDENCE CHECKLIST FOR THIS QUESTION:
- Ranking: report the original Alpha value for EVERY category shown on the chart.
- Operand: report the original Beta value of each finally selected category in evidence.
- A cell already reported for ranking or filtering is reported only once. Values written only in bindings or work do not count as evidence.
